result.topic_en: Notes on reducing an expression in the H^{αβ} coefficients to the form with minimal sum of squared coefficients, and the condition equation among the six edges of a tetrahedron derived from linear relations with T^1, T^2, T^3.
result.transcription:
Jedes $\Delta = H^{01}D^{01} + H^{02}D^{02} +$ u. s. w. gesetzt, wird in die
[-Form-] gebracht wo die Summe der Quadrate der Coefficienten
ein Minimum wird indem man schreibt
anstatt $H^{01} \ldots\ldots \frac{1}{4}(2H^{01} - H^{20} - H^{30} + H^{21} + H^{31})$
$H^{02} \ldots\ldots \frac{1}{4}(2H^{02} - H^{10} - H^{30} + H^{12} + H^{32})$
u. s. w.
wo $H^{\alpha\beta} = -H^{\beta\alpha}$
Zwischen den Seiten und $T^1, T^2, T^3$ gibt es die Gleichungen
$0 = 2.01^2 T^1 + (01^2 + 02^2 - 12^2) T^2 + (01^2 + 03^2 - 13^2) T^3$
$0 = (01^2 + 02^2 - 12^2) T^1 + 2.02^2 T^2 + (02^2 + 03^2 - 23^2) T^3$
$0 = (01^2 + 03^2 - 13^2) T^1 + (02^2 + 03^2 - 23^2) T^2 + 2.03^2 T^3$
Schreibt man dafür
$0 = AT^1 + cT^2 + bT^3$
$0 = cT^1 + BT^2 + aT^3$
$0 = bT^1 + aT^2 + CT^3$
so wird
$ABC + 2abc =$ [-$aaA + bbB + ccC$-] {+$aaA + bbB + ccC$+}
welches die zwischen den sechs Seiten
Statt findende Bedingungsgleichung ist.
Entwickelt steht dieselbe hinter meinem Exemplare des Ersten
Theils der Schumacherschen Übersetzung von Carnots Geometrie de position.

methods.what: Replacing coefficients by symmetrized combinations so that the sum of squares of the coefficients becomes minimal (least-squares normalization of an antisymmetric coefficient system)
Linear relations between the six edges of a tetrahedron and quantities T^1,T^2,T^3 (Gram-type matrix of edge vectors from vertex 0)
Vanishing of the symmetric 3x3 determinant giving the condition equation among the six distances (Cayley–Menger-type relation for four coplanar points)
